create table merchant
(
    id               bigint unsigned auto_increment
        primary key,
    user_id          bigint unsigned                         not null comment '对应 users.id',
    shop_name        varchar(100)                            null comment '店铺名称',
    shop_logo        varchar(500)                            null comment '店铺 logo',
    shop_desc        text                                    null comment '店铺简介',
    business_license varchar(500)                            null comment '营业执照照片 URL',
    real_name_ver_sn varchar(50)                             null comment '实名认证序列号',
    contact_phone    varchar(20)                             null comment '商家客服电话',
    contact_email    varchar(100)                            null comment '商家客服邮箱',
    status           tinyint       default 0                 not null comment '0待审核 1正常营业 2平台冻结 3主动关闭 4封禁',
    reason           text                                    null comment '审核/冻结/封禁原因',
    created_at       timestamp     default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP null,
    updated_at       timestamp     default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP null on update CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    book_cnt         int           default 0                 null comment '在售图书数',
    order_cnt        int           default 0                 null comment '历史订单数',
    rating           decimal(3, 2) default 5.00              null comment '店铺评分',
    constraint uq_merchant_user
        unique (user_id),
    constraint fk_merchant_user
        foreign key (user_id) references users (id)
)
    comment '商家档案';
